cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said we'd take it offline, so I've shut my laptop. You'll hear my idea before Sam's, won't you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Offline means after the meeting. Sam booked this slot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, after. You keep his slot very safe. Save me the first five minutes when we finish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hear both of you together over lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Together. That's how you'd handle anyone. Sit beside me, at least; I'll explain without having to raise my voice.
